_comment: The try-it block of the home page: QuizBuks's own quiz in each language. url: the share link of the publication (https://quizbuks.com/taker/p/<id>); qr: a path under public/ to a QR image (PNG or SVG) of that link, or empty to render it from the url is not possible here, so leave empty to show the placeholder. Both empty: the block shows 'coming soon'.
